title: David Bailey suffers minor ankle injury at Jets training camp

sources.title: David Bailey suffers minor ankle injury at Jets training camp
sources.description: Jets rookie pass rusher David Bailey sustained an ankle injury at Jets training camp practice on Saturday. It does not sound serious. Bailey has been one of the stories of Jets training camp. Of course you never know for sure about a player until he starts producing in real games. But by all accounts he […]
